The '''Taanab Spaceport''' was a major [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the planet [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]].

This spaceport was a scene of [[Mission to Taanab|incident]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] when [[Disciples of Ragnos]] cultists released a [[Taanab mutant rancor|mutated rancor]] into the complex. At this particular event, many [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] were destroyed by the mutated rancor before [[Jaden Korr]] was able to trap it in between a moving container and a force field in one of the loading docks, this way killing it.
